name: tempo-env
what: rt-fix9's 15033 class (a part's timing differs on one computer after tempo changes: Drums' automation at 4, 8, 12 s on one computer and 4.706, 9.412, 14.118 s on another, the same points under a map 17/20 of the other), made by hand as its frozen seed's note asked (rt-sync2f). Bee is offline from 20 s to 45 s. At 22 s James puts in 70 tempo steps, one every half second from 2 s. At 24 s, on the old map, Bee moves Gtr to 30 s (quarter note 60) and adds a Drums automation point at 20 s (quarter note 40). The two cross when Bee comes back. Every computer must end with Gtr and the point on the beats Bee put them on. Before rt-sync2f a version carried the map its seconds were read under (`tm`), and only up to 64 points ('shortcut: a map of more than MAP_MAX points isn't carried'): James and Cee put Bee's Gtr and point at their old seconds, off their beats, while REAPER moved Bee's own onto them: Gtr differs, and Drums' automation differs (E differs), as in the class. Now they travel in quarter notes (lib/beats.lua), whatever the map's length. The frozen seed 13007 this replaces passed by luck since rt-sync2c (its note said so).

edits.lua: for i = 0, 69 do reaper.SetTempoTimeSigMarker(F.proj, -1, 2 + i * 0.5, -1, -1, 100 + (i % 7) * 5, 4, 4, false) end; return '70 tempo steps from 2 s'

reaper.SetMediaItemInfo_Value(item('Gtr'), 'D_POSITION', 30); local t = track('Drums'); t.body = t.body:gsub('
PT 12 0.7 0', '
PT 12 0.7 0
PT 20 0.4 0', 1); F.changed(); return 'Gtr to 30 s, and a Drums point at 20 s'

checks.what: the 70 steps here, and Gtr on quarter note 60
checks.lua: assert(reaper.CountTempoTimeSigMarkers(F.proj) >= 70, 'the map has ' .. reaper.CountTempoTimeSigMarkers(F.proj) .. ' points'); local p = reaper.GetMediaItemInfo_Value(item('Gtr'), 'D_POSITION'); local q = reaper.TimeMap2_timeToQN(F.proj, p); assert(math.abs(q - 60) < 1e-5, 'Gtr at ' .. p .. ' s, quarter note ' .. q .. ', not 60')

checks.what: the Drums point Bee added on quarter note 40
checks.lua: local body = track('Drums').body; local found; for t, v in body:gmatch('\nPT (%S+) (%S+)') do if tonumber(v) == 0.4 then found = tonumber(t) end end; assert(found, 'no point of 0.4 on Drums'); local q = reaper.TimeMap2_timeToQN(F.proj, found); assert(math.abs(q - 40) < 1e-5, 'the point at ' .. found .. ' s, quarter note ' .. q .. ', not 40')
